main_reasons: Unexplained $425,172 'Other income' (vs $87,891 prior year) turns a $85,891 operating loss into $273,639 net income; only $27,311 forfeited customer deposit is disclosed as a source
Customer deposits fell $457K while revenue rose $430K (42%) with gross margin dropping 45% to 38%; revenue/deposit cut-off and classification risk
CEO is also sole principal accounting officer; disclosed material weakness (lack of segregation of duties), ineffective disclosure controls, 6 employees
Small offshore auditor (New Delhi) since 2023; audit opinion covers only FY2025 and cites the prior-year accumulated deficit in the going-concern paragraph, suggesting low audit quality

Numerous internal inconsistencies: customer concentration (four customers 87% vs two customers 77%), NOL carryforward revised from $8.2M to $5.2M without explanation, blank allowance/bad-debt figures, 'net cash used' wording on positive 2024 cash flow
Inventory reserve (~78% of gross inventory) is a large judgmental estimate flagged as a critical audit matter
Going concern doubt, negative working capital of ~$961K, stockholders' deficit, growing CEO loans and accrued CEO compensation of $637K
Mitigating: very small scale, no equity raising, $0.01 stock with little market incentive to inflate results; most issues look like sloppiness rather than deliberate fraud
